children: Boston Scientific announced that Arthur C. Butcher will retire as Executive Vice President and Group President, MedSurg and Asia Pacific, effective January 1, 2027, and will serve as a senior advisor through February 26, 2027.
Executive Vice President and Group President, MedSurg and Asia Pacific
Retirement effective January 1, 2027; senior advisor through February 26, 2027

Will receive prorated base salary at current annual rate of $780,000 while serving as senior advisor; eligible for payments/benefits under Company's Executive Retirement Plan, 2026 Annual Bonus Plan and Long-Term Incentive Program per filed plans
